name: Alejandro Ruiz Morales
title: Principal Product Manager
summary: Highly accomplished Principal Product Manager with over 10 years of experience driving product vision, strategy, and execution for SaaS and B2B platforms. Proven track record of launching successful products, leading cross-functional teams, and achieving significant business growth through data-driven decision-making and customer-centric approaches. Expertise in scaling products and optimizing user experiences in competitive markets.

bullets: Led the strategic development and launch of a new AI-powered analytics platform, resulting in a 25% increase in enterprise customer acquisition and a 15% uplift in annual recurring revenue within the first year.
Managed a portfolio of products generating over €5M in annual revenue, optimizing features based on user feedback and market trends, leading to a 90% customer retention rate.
Mentored a team of 3 product managers, establishing best practices for product lifecycle management and agile development, improving team efficiency by 20%.
Collaborated with engineering, design, and sales teams to define product roadmaps and prioritize features, achieving 95% on-time delivery for major releases.
Oversaw the product lifecycle for a key B2B SaaS platform, increasing user engagement by 30% through targeted feature enhancements and UX improvements.
Conducted extensive market research and competitive analysis to identify new growth opportunities, leading to the development of two successful product lines that added €2M to the company's revenue.
Implemented A/B testing frameworks for core features, driving a 10% conversion rate optimization across critical user flows.
Managed the development and release of mobile applications, achieving over 500,000 downloads and a 4.5-star rating on app stores.
Collaborated closely with engineering and design teams to translate business requirements into detailed product specifications and user stories.
Analyzed product performance metrics to identify areas for improvement, contributing to a 20% reduction in user churn.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering
